opening_hours_midday_consistency.name: opening_hours_midday_consistency
opening_hours_midday_consistency.value: NOT "opening_hours"."has_midday_break" OR ("opening_hours"."afternoon_open" IS NOT NULL AND "opening_hours"."afternoon_close" IS NOT NULL)

blog_notifications_single_target.name: blog_notifications_single_target
blog_notifications_single_target.value: ("blog_notifications"."post_id" IS NOT NULL AND NOT ("blog_notifications"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "blog_notifications"."review_id" IS NOT NULL))

blog_reports_single_target.name: blog_reports_single_target
blog_reports_single_target.value: ((("blog_reports"."post_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("blog_reports"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("blog_reports"."review_id" IS NOT NULL)::int) = 1)

blog_subscribers_token_purpose_check.name: blog_subscribers_token_purpose_check
blog_subscribers_token_purpose_check.value: "blog_subscribers"."confirmation_token_hash" IS NULL OR "blog_subscribers"."unsubscribe_token_hash" IS NULL OR "blog_subscribers"."confirmation_token_hash" <> "blog_subscribers"."unsubscribe_token_hash" OR ("blog_subscribers"."token" IS NULL AND "blog_subscribers"."token_used_at" IS NOT NULL)

service_notification_target_consistency.name: service_notification_target_consistency
service_notification_target_consistency.value: CASE WHEN "service_notifications"."type" IN ('NEW_COMMENT','REPLY_TO_COMMENT') THEN "service_notifications"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "service_notifications"."review_id" IS NULL WHEN "service_notifications"."type" IN ('NEW_REVIEW','REVIEW_APPROVED','REVIEW_REJECTED') THEN "service_notifications"."review_id" IS NOT NULL AND "service_notifications"."comment_id" IS NULL WHEN "service_notifications"."type" IN ('SERVICE_PUBLISHED','SERVICE_MENTION') THEN "service_notifications"."comment_id" IS NULL AND "service_notifications"."review_id" IS NULL ELSE FALSE END

service_reports_single_target.name: service_reports_single_target
service_reports_single_target.value: ((CASE WHEN "service_reports"."service_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN "service_reports"."comment_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN "service_reports"."review_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) = 1

events_dates_order.name: events_dates_order
events_dates_order.value: "events"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "events"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "events"."ends_at" >= "events"."starts_at"

order_return_lines_quantities.name: order_return_lines_quantities
order_return_lines_quantities.value:
"order_return_lines"."quantity" > 0
    and ("order_return_lines"."accepted_quantity" is null or ("order_return_lines"."accepted_quantity" >= 0 and "order_return_lines"."accepted_quantity" <= "order_return_lines"."quantity"))
    and ("order_return_lines"."restocked_quantity" is null or ("order_return_lines"."restocked_quantity" >= 0 and "order_return_lines"."restocked_quantity" <= coalesce("order_return_lines"."accepted_quantity", 0)))
